materi.judul: Bahasa Inggris Wajib SMA — Persiapan TKA 2026 (Edisi Cara Gemilang)
materi.deskripsi: Materi wajib kelas 12 seri TKA Bahasa Inggris: narrative, recount, procedure, analytical exposition, dan infographic reading. Impor bab tambahan pakai mode "tambah" pada materi ini.
daftarPustaka: Bank owner: salinan digital HTML bab 1,3,4,6,7 buku seri Sukses TKA SMA + tabel kunci di tiap HTML + pembahasan di HTML/PDF "08 Pembahasan"; kunci mengikuti cetakan asli.
Sumber teks adaptasi per stimulus tercantum pada masing-masing teks.
Kartu Cara Gemilang, tabel pola soal, dan Zona Berlatih = Gemilang Drill tim Gemilang mengikuti pola soal bank owner.

bab.ringkasan: Social function persuade-that-is-the-case, struktur thesis-arguments-reiteration, language features, pembeda analytical-vs-hortatory (IS-THE-CASE TEST), pola soal NOT-mentioned/argumen-terkuat/kategorisasi/antonim — dengan jodohkan struktur, benar/salah, isian rumpang, CG-EXPO, dan 25 soal resmi bank (cybersecurity, national parks, genetic medicine, migration, poetry) + pembahasan dua jalur.

sections.teks: Analytical Exposition: Persuading that Something IS the Case

Analytical exposition persuades the readers that something is the case — menegaskan bahwa suatu keadaan/klaim memang benar adanya lewat argumen. Struktur: Thesis - Arguments - Reiteration (penegasan ulang, BUKAN rekomendasi).

Pasangan sekaligus pembeda hortatory: analytical menutup dengan REITERATION ("karena itu benar demikian"), hortatory dengan RECOMMENDATION ("karena itu lakukan ini"). Satu tes sederhana memisahkan keduanya di semua soal purpose/structure.

Analytical exposition seperti surat pendapat ahli: membuka posisi, menumpuk bukti, lalu menegaskan ulang posisi awal dengan kata-kata baru. Tidak ada ajakan bertindak — yang diminta hanya satu: setuju bahwa keadaannya memang begitu.

items: Arguments — alasan & bukti pendukung (satu paragraf per argumen).
Reiteration — penegasan ulang tesis di penutup (berbeda dari recommendation!).

items.teks: Analytical exposition ends with a reiteration of the thesis.
Its social function is to persuade that something is the case.
Recommendation (should/must) is the typical closing of analytical exposition.
Thinking verbs (think, believe, realize) are common language features.

sections.teks: Tutup teks dengan pertanyaan: penulis ingin kita PERCAYAI keadaan (analytical) atau MELAKUKAN tindakan (hortatory)? Percayai = reiteration; lakukan = recommendation.
items: Petakan T-A-R: thesis (paragraf 1), satu argumen per paragraf tengah, penutup reiteration/recommendation.
Soal argumen terkuat/terdukung = cari argumen dengan bukti/data ilmiah eksplisit.
Soal NOT mentioned = eliminasi daftar eksplisit teks satu per satu.

sections.teks: Opsi purpose "to recommend how to..." menempel di analytical sebagai pengecoh hortatory. Cek kalimat penutup teks: menegaskan ulang (= analytical) atau menyerukan tindakan (= hortatory).

items.soal: The closing part of an analytical exposition that restates the thesis is called ...
opsi: recommendation
reiteration
re-orientation
coda
goal
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: reiteration = penegasan ulang (bank h.98). Jalur Cara Gemilang: IS-THE-CASE TEST.

items.soal: A text argues that urban trees cool cities and ends: "Thus, urban trees are indeed vital infrastructure." The text is ...
opsi: hortatory exposition
analytical exposition
procedure
narrative
recount
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: penutup menegaskan klaim (indeed vital) tanpa should = analytical. Jalur Cara Gemilang: IS-THE-CASE TEST lulus.

items.soal: Which connective typically signals a new argument in analytical exposition?
opsi: furthermore
once
after that
finally pour
meanwhile stir
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: furthermore = penambah argumen; once/after that milik procedure. Jalur Cara Gemilang: connective antarargumen vs antarlangkah.

rows.w: Klaim tesis atau kalimat inti paragraf.

items.teks: The restatement of the thesis at the end of an analytical exposition is called ...
Paragraphs that give reasons and evidence are called ...

sections.teks: Bandingkan dua teks bab 5 dan bab 6 (hortatory vs analytical) dalam tabel tiga baris: pembuka, isi, penutup. Selisih satu baris penutup itulah yang diuji hampir semua soal structure/purpose.
25 soal resmi bab ini memakai 5 analytical: keamanan siber, taman nasional, kedokteran genetik, migrasi ekonomi, dan puisi-otak. Petakan T-A-R sebelum menyentuh opsi.

ujiPemahaman.soal:
Read the following text carefully!

In today's interconnected world, cybersecurity awareness has become a fundamental necessity. The rapid growth of digital platforms for banking, education, shopping, and communication has created countless opportunities, but it has also exposed individuals and organizations to cyber threats. Hackers no longer target only large corporations. Ordinary users are equally vulnerable to phishing emails, identity theft, and ransomware attacks. Without awareness, people may unknowingly compromise their personal data, financial security, and even national safety. Thus, raising awareness is the first line of defense against the dangers of the digital age.

Cybersecurity awareness is crucial because technology alone cannot guarantee protection. Many breaches occur due to human error, such as clicking on suspicious links, reusing weak passwords, or ignoring software updates. By educating users about safe practices — like enabling two-factor authentication, using password managers, and avoiding public Wi-Fi for sensitive transactions — risks can be significantly reduced. Organizations also benefit from regular training programs that keep employees updated on evolving threats. Awareness empowers individuals to recognize warning signs and respond appropriately, making them active participants in safeguarding digital systems rather than passive victims.

Finally, cybersecurity awareness ensures trust and resilience in society. Businesses that prioritize awareness build stronger reputations, as customers feel confident their data is protected. Governments and schools that promote digital literacy prepare citizens to navigate online spaces responsibly. In contrast, neglecting awareness leads to financial losses, reputational damage, and weakened public confidence. The digital age offers immense opportunities, but only those who are informed and vigilant can fully enjoy its benefits. Therefore, cybersecurity awareness is not optional; it is essential for protecting privacy, maintaining trust, and ensuring safety in our increasingly digital lives.

(adapted from various sources)

What is the main idea of the text?
opsi: Cybersecurity awareness is only the duty of IT staff in large companies.
Cybersecurity awareness is unnecessary for ordinary users in daily activities.
Cybersecurity awareness is essential to protect people and organizations in the digital era.
Cybersecurity awareness is mainly important for governments and national defense.
Cybersecurity awareness is limited to online shopping and e-commerce platforms.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: Gagasan utama teks adalah kesadaran akan keamanan siber sangat penting untuk melindungi individu dan organisasi di era digital. Jalur Cara Gemilang: Main idea = tesis: kesadaran keamanan siber penting untuk melindungi data.

ujiPemahaman.soal:
Read the following text carefully!

National parks play a vital role in conserving biodiversity by protecting large areas of natural habitat from urban development, agriculture, and industrial activities. These protected zones allow ecosystems to function naturally, providing safe havens for countless species of plants and animals. For example, the U.S. National Park Service emphasizes that parks must steward resources to preserve ecological integrity and authenticity, ensuring that visitors experience landscapes in their natural state. By securing land from exploitation, national parks prevent habitat loss, which is one of the leading causes of species extinction worldwide.

Beyond habitat protection, national parks contribute to maintaining genetic diversity through wildlife corridors and expansive ecosystems. These corridors allow species to migrate, adapt, and interbreed, reducing the risks of isolation and genetic decline. Studies highlight that national parks serve as sanctuaries where rare and endangered species can survive, such as tigers in India's Ranthambore National Park or orangutans in Indonesia's Tanjung Puting National Park. By limiting human interference, parks create conditions where biodiversity flourishes, supporting the overall health of the planet.

Ultimately, national parks strengthen resilience against climate change and environmental pressures. Forests, wetlands, and coral reefs within these protected areas act as natural buffers, absorbing carbon, regulating water cycles, and sustaining food chains. They also provide opportunities for scientific research, education, and ecotourism, which raise awareness about conservation. Without national parks, many ecosystems would collapse under the weight of deforestation, pollution, and urban expansion. Therefore, safeguarding biodiversity through national parks is not only about protecting wildlife but also about ensuring ecological stability and human survival.

(adapted from various sources)

What is the writer's purpose in writing the text?
opsi: To entertain readers with stories about wildlife adventures in different countries
To persuade readers that national parks are essential for safeguarding biodiversity
To inform readers about the history of national parks in the United States
To describe tourism activities available in national parks around the world
To explain how governments earn money from protected areas and ecotourism
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: Karena teks ini merupakan teks eksposisi, maka tujuan penulis adalah membujuk pembaca bahwa taman nasional sangat penting untuk melindungi keanekaragaman hayati. Jalur Cara Gemilang: Purpose analytical = persuade that something IS the case (bukan should).

Genetic studies are essential in modern medicine because they allow scientists and doctors to identify mutations that cause hereditary diseases. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), advances since the Human Genome Project have made it possible to translate genetic discoveries into clinical practice, helping prevent conditions linked to inherited mutations. By analyzing DNA, researchers can detect whether individuals carry genes associated with disorders such as cystic fibrosis, Huntington's disease, or sickle cell anemia. This knowledge empowers families to make informed health decisions and reduces the risk of passing these conditions to future generations.

Beyond detection, genetic studies provide opportunities for early intervention. Screening programs allow doctors to monitor individuals at higher risk and recommend lifestyle changes, medical treatments, or preventive measures before symptoms appear. For example, genetic counseling helps families understand inheritance patterns and guides them in planning for healthy pregnancies. International studies emphasize that identifying carriers of recessive mutations can prevent the transmission of severe genetic disorders. ujiPemahaman.soal:
Read the following text carefully!

Migration has long served as a catalyst for economic growth and social transformation. The International Organization for Migration (IOM) notes that migrants fill labor shortages, stimulate innovation, and balance demographic shifts. In many advanced economies, migration helps counter aging populations and declining birth rates. Consequently, the arrival of new workers and skills sustains productivity and ensures stability across industries such as healthcare and technology.

Moreover, migration enriches societies culturally and socially. The United Nations emphasizes that migrants introduce traditions, languages, and perspectives which encourage dialogue and tolerance. This diversity strengthens social cohesion when communities adopt inclusive policies. Migrants also participate in civic life through volunteerism and community initiatives, thereby reinforcing the social fabric of host nations. Thus, migration is not only about labor mobility but also about building vibrant, multicultural societies.

In addition, remittances highlight migration's global impact. The World Bank reports that migrants send hundreds of billions of dollars annually to their countries of origin, often exceeding official aid. These funds support education, healthcare, and small businesses, reducing poverty and stimulating local economies. As a result, migration generates a dual benefit: host nations gain workers and innovation, while origin countries receive financial support and knowledge transfer. This exchange fosters stronger economic ties and shared prosperity.

To conclude, migration contributes to economic and social development by addressing labor needs, promoting cultural diversity, and sustaining financial flows worldwide. International evidence confirms that when migration is managed responsibly, both sending and receiving nations benefit. Therefore, migration should be regarded not as a burden but as an opportunity to build resilient economies and inclusive societies.

(adapted from various sources)

ujiPemahaman.soal:
Read the following text carefully!

Poetry is not only an artistic form but also a medium that nurtures emotional intelligence. Emotional intelligence refers to the ability to recognize, understand, and manage emotions in oneself and others. Research published in Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience highlights that poetry, like music, activates neural circuits linked to emotional processing, showing its capacity to elicit strong feelings and reflection. Thus, engaging with poetry provides readers with opportunities to explore emotions deeply and develop empathy, self-awareness, and regulation.

First, poetry fosters empathy by presenting diverse perspectives and emotional experiences. A survey study in the International Journal of Science, Engineering and Technology found that literature, including poetry, enhances empathic capacities among students and professionals by exposing them to varied human conditions. When readers encounter verses about joy, grief, or resilience, they imaginatively step into others' lives. This process builds compassion and tolerance, making poetry a bridge to understanding cultural diversity and interpersonal struggles.

Second, poetry strengthens self-awareness and emotional regulation. The symbolic and condensed nature of poems encourages readers to pause and reflect on metaphors and imagery. Neuroscientific evidence suggests that such aesthetic experiences stimulate psychophysiological responses, helping individuals confront and articulate their own emotions. Writing or reading poetry also provides a safe outlet for intense feelings. Instead of suppressing emotions, individuals can channel them into creative language, reducing stress and promoting resilience.

In conclusion, international studies confirm that poetry enhances emotional intelligence by cultivating empathy, encouraging self-awareness, and supporting emotional regulation. Its artistic qualities invite readers to engage with emotions in meaningful ways, making poetry not only a cultural treasure but also a valuable tool for personal development. Therefore, poetry should be embraced as a pathway to deeper emotional understanding and stronger human connections.

(adapted from various sources)
